decision.title: The CLI's WebAssembly budget is 7,000,000 / 1,500,000 bytes (owner)
decision.summary: The CLI's WebAssembly budget rises to 7,000,000 bytes stripped and 1,500,000 gzipped, while the sxml.wasm budgets stay.

body.p: on the owner's choice. The CLI module grew to 5,927,297 bytes stripped and 1,267,818 gzipped (the XQuery Update grammar, , and the HTML parser, ), over 's 5,500,000 / 1,250,000. The CLI's WebAssembly build runs sxml in Node, where size matters less than for sxml.wasm, so its budget rises to 7,000,000 / 1,500,000 with room for the rest of Phase 7. The sxml.wasm budgets of and stay.
